1062 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
360 days before 09-05 (May 9) 1062:  
Step back 360 days = 365 days - 5 days → go back 1 year (to 1061) then add 5 days forward from May 9, 1061.  
May 9, 1061 minus 1 year = May 9, 1061.  
Now add 5 days: May 9 + 5 days = May 14, 1061.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1061-05-14
